result.instructions: Tools for Apicbase, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which recipes changed this week, and what does each one cost to make?"; "List the suppliers of my library and their ordering details."; "Show the open purchase orders for the Main outlet.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Apicbase data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run apicbase_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run apicbase_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run apicbase_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. apicbase_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: apicbase_get_active_library
tools.title: Get the active library
tools.description: The library these tools read (id, name, status) and the signed-in user's name. Start here to check the connection.

tools.name: apicbase_list_libraries
tools.title: List libraries
tools.description: Every library the signed-in user can access (id, name, status). Switching libraries in Apicbase changes the active library.

tools.name: apicbase_get_currency
tools.title: Get the default currency
tools.description: The library's default currency (code, symbol, name). Monetary values are shown in this currency.

tools.name: apicbase_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom field definitions
tools.description: The custom fields defined in the library, with their type and the model they apply to. Use them to read custom values on other records.

tools.name: apicbase_list_outlets
tools.title: List outlets
tools.description: The outlets (locations) of the library, one page at a time, with their details.

ordering.description: Sort field, for example name or -modified_date (prefix - for descending).

tools.name: apicbase_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: The users of the library, one page at a time. The reply includes each user's name and email.

tools.name: apicbase_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: One user of the library by id, with the roles and outlets they hold.

tools.name: apicbase_list_user_roles
tools.title: List user roles
tools.description: The user roles defined in the library. Roles set what each user may do in Apicbase.

tools.name: apicbase_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: The suppliers of the library, one page at a time.

ordering.description: Sort field, for example name or -modified_date (prefix - for descending).

tools.name: apicbase_get_supplier
tools.title: Get a supplier
tools.description: One supplier by id, with its contact and ordering details.

tools.name: apicbase_list_supplier_packages
tools.title: List supplier packages
tools.description: The supplier packages (how a supplier sells a stock item: package size, article number, price), one page at a time.

orderable.description: Only orderable (true) or not orderable (false) packages.

ordering.description: Sort field, for example name or -modified_date (prefix - for descending).

tools.name: apicbase_list_ingredients
tools.title: List ingredients
tools.description: The ingredients of the library, one page at a time. Filter by name, supplier or the last change date.

modified_date__gt.description: Only ingredients changed after this date (sync).

ordering.description: Sort field, for example name or -modified_date (prefix - for descending).

tools.name: apicbase_get_ingredient
tools.title: Get an ingredient
tools.description: One ingredient by id, with its composition and allergen data.

tools.name: apicbase_list_recipes
tools.title: List recipes
tools.description: The recipes of the library, one page at a time. Filter by name, outlet or the last change date.

outlet.description: Only recipes linked to this outlet id.

modified_date__gt.description: Only recipes changed after this date (sync).

ordering.description: Sort field, for example name or -modified_date (prefix - for descending).

tools.name: apicbase_get_recipe
tools.title: Get a recipe
tools.description: One recipe by id: its yield, sell price, outlet prices and nutrition summary. Ingredient lines are in the reply.

tools.name: apicbase_get_recipe_financials
tools.title: Get recipe financials
tools.description: The food cost and margin of one recipe, optionally for one outlet.

outlet.description: The outlet id whose prices and costs to use.

food_cost_mode.description: The food cost mode the vendor accepts (see the reply).

tools.name: apicbase_list_menus
tools.title: List menus
tools.description: The menus of the library, one page at a time. Filter by name or the last change date.

modified_date__gt.description: Only menus changed after this date (sync).

ordering.description: Sort field, for example name or -modified_date (prefix - for descending).

tools.name: apicbase_list_stock_items
tools.title: List stock items
tools.description: The stock items of the library (what is counted and ordered), one page at a time.

name.description: Only stock items whose name matches.

ordering.description: Sort field, for example name or -modified_date (prefix - for descending).

tools.name: apicbase_list_waste_events
tools.title: List waste events
tools.description: The waste events recorded for one outlet (stock thrown away), one page at a time.

ordering.description: Sort field, for example name or -modified_date (prefix - for descending).

tools.name: apicbase_list_purchase_orders
tools.title: List purchase orders
tools.description: The purchase orders of the library, one page at a time. Filter by supplier, outlet or status.

supplier.description: Only orders for this supplier id.

outlet.description: Only orders for this outlet id.

ordering.description: Sort field, for example name or -modified_date (prefix - for descending).

tools.name: apicbase_get_purchase_order
tools.title: Get a purchase order
tools.description: One purchase order by id, with its lines.

tools.name: apicbase_global_search
tools.title: Search the library
tools.description: Search ingredients, recipes, menus, stock items, purchase orders and more for a text. The reply groups the hits by type.
